story.title: Fun in the Sun

panels.desc: A bright sunny picnic on the wide stepping stones close to the far bank: a round striped rug is spread on the biggest stone, and a small round green bug with black spots sits in the middle of it. Hedgie peers into his big brown mug and finds a second bug swimming in it, pulling a face; Bun points at the bug on the rug; Pip says the word backwards; Beads sunbathes on a lily pad. Hidden in the picture: the bug, the rug, the mug. Grumble does NOT appear.

lines.text: Look! A bug on the rug!

panels.ko: 햇살 좋은 소풍이에요. 깔개 위에 벌레, 헤지 머그컵에도 벌레! 핍은 "겁!"

panels.desc: Beads threads b-u-g and a new stone pops up; a tiny fluffy white puppy races along the stepping stones with motion lines, chasing the bug; the smiling sun shines overhead; Bun sits on the rug happily biting into a round sesame bun; Hedgie laughs. Hidden in the picture: the bug, the pup, the sun, the bun in Bun's paws. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: b-u-g! 새 돌이 솟아요. 강아지가 벌레를 쫓아 달려요. 번이 빵을 먹어요.

panels.desc: The very last gap of water before the far bank: a blue cup with white stars floats in it. Beads threads c-u-p and the last stepping stone rises under the cup, completing the bridge of stones all the way across the pond; Pip shoots straight up into the air above the bridge with its wings wide, glowing, a trail of sparkles below it; Bun and Hedgie stand on the last stone shouting up at Pip; the pup and the cat wait on the bank. Hidden in the picture: the cup, Pip going up with a big upward swirl of sparkles. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 마지막 틈에 컵이 떠 있어요. c-u-p! 마지막 돌이 솟아 다리가 완성! 핍이 하늘로 솟아올라요.

panels.desc: Sunset on the far bank, the complete bridge of stepping stones stretching back across the pond behind the friends. A single big glowing golden music note has risen out of the pond water and floats into Pip, who stands on the last stone singing with its beak wide open and little golden notes streaming out. Grumble has crossed the whole bridge with his lantern shining like a small sun, and Bun has thrown her arms around him in a big hug while he blinks in surprise, nightcap crooked; Hedgie wears a pointy party hat; the pup runs in circles; Beads cheers. Hidden in the picture: the hug, the setting sun, the party hat, the running pup.
panels.ko: 건너편 둑, 해질녘. 연못에서 금빛 음표가 나와 핍에게 들어가요. 핍이 노래해요. 번이 그럼블을 꼭 안아요.

ask.en: What comes out of the water?

story.synopsis_ko: 햇살 소풍에 깔개 위 벌레, 머그컵 속 벌레! 강아지가 달리고 번은 빵을 먹어요. 마지막 틈에 c-u-p 으로 돌이 솟아 다리가 완성됐어요! 연못에서 노래 조각이 나와 핍이 노래해요. 번이 그럼블을 꼭 안아 줘요.
story.so_far_ko: 여우에게서 상자를 되찾고 그럼블이 처음 웃었어요.
story.goal_ko: 마지막 돌을 놓아 다리를 완성하고 -ug·-un·-up 단어를 읽어요.

Camera still. Warm, joyful, child-friendly. No text.
